**Track A fixture merged (#245); next = C3 plainfiles backend, drafted #246 (reasoned: C is n=1, one slice from done)**

## State 2026-07-12
**Track A fixture phase COMPLETE + merged:** A2 #231, A3 #239 (PRs #240/#241/#242+#243), A4 #244 (PR #245). All in `feature/v2.0.0`. Remaining Track A = SCIT bundle (endpoint-gated).

## Next slice decision: C3 (endorsed with evidence, not blind agreement)
Verified state: Track C is ~80% done but **n=1** — `memory-format.md` (C0 #201), `lib/format.mjs`+`store.mjs`+`secret-scrub.mjs` (C1 #205/#214), `engram-export/import.mjs`+`migrate-v1.mjs` (C2 #217), C4 #229 (transitional-window close) all exist, but `brain/scripts/memory/backends/` has ONLY `engram.mjs`. **No `plainfiles.mjs`.** Track B is at ZERO (`harness/backends/` has only `gentle-ai.mjs`; no `sdd-layout.md`/`sdd-layout.mjs`/`plain`/`fission`).

**Why C3 before B** (overrides PLAN's nominal A→B→C priority): (1) PLAN §0.2's own caveat — "C has a data-migration cost that grows with every commit, do not let it slip past B"; C has a clock, B doesn't. (2) C is ONE keystone slice from n≥2; B is a 4-slice track from scratch. (3) C3 is small/self-contained (plainfiles.mjs: save appends record, search=rg, share/pull no-ops; zero deps; reuses format.mjs). (4) Realizes the DoD §11.4 "no new n=1 ports" bar + makes the durability claim ("git clone+grep answers what decisions") executable. (5) Unblocks the true engram↔plainfiles round-trip + D1 (memory-gate v2). **After C3, Track B becomes the priority — don't let B slip forever.**

**C3 drafted = issue #246** (OPEN, type:feature, needs human status:approved). Base feature/v2.0.0. See [[sdd/issue-244-a4/resume]], [[memory/orphaned-chunks-post-c4]] (chunks-still-materializing finding relates to whether C4 #229's chunk-retirement fully landed — worth checking during C3).

**Standing:** push+PR without asking; merge + issue-approval human-gated ([[workflow/push-pr-authorization]]).
